data.narrative:
Comand AI is a Seed-stage defense and security AI company founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Antoine Chassan, which has raised €11.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI—all operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €11.5M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, yielding €29M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The median valuation across this peer set is $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: $24M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $214M. The substantial gap between stage-progression ($29M) and peer-median ($400M) reflects tension between early-stage capital deployed and relative valuations commanded by peers in this high-growth, venture-intensive sector. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer traction, technical differentiation relative to the peer set, and whether Comand AI's profile aligns with the upper or lower quartile of the comparable universe. Additional diligence on unit economics and defensibility would narrow this range.
